cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And if your apology follows, do we split the victory?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why is going first carrying all the risk?
